behavior.publication: Diagnostic input follows the accepted native terrain publication; stale diagnostic hidden during authoring replacement; native camera/LOD updates do not hide the network or start input.

assertions: Shared/native inspection fields agree; ordinary surface has no false zero sheet.
Actual cavity is negative; exterior is excluded; backfill removes highlighted air; unrelated authored excavation is excluded.
Native mesh vertices have maximum sampled cave-field residual below 0.5 m at this native LOD.
Native connected cave volume is visibly cyan through dimmed terrain and lighting restores on disable.
Ninety navigation frames keep the native diagnostic present, start no new stamp/recipe input and copy no mesh.
A live recipe edit removes surface entrances, reuses both native world owners, publishes both plans and reframes the network.
Saved user asset cold-loads and roundtrips its own payload; it is not overwritten by the portable fixture.

limits: Editor inspection proof, not a new cooked cave mining/walking/collision/sculpt-save qualification.
Cave formation remains the first bounded structural fissure family. Karst, lava tubes, larger caverns and host-specific clipping are separate work.
Native LOD triangulates the cave field; this is not an exact analytic surface mesh.
Performance is for the frozen bounded recipe/view on the recorded host.
